Antes de volar compruebe si la zona de v: Before flying, check whether the flight area is in an urban environment. Definition of urban environment:
a) Núcleos de población con áreas consol: a) Population centres with areas consolidated by buildings;
b) Áreas residenciales, comerciales o in: b) Residential, commercial or industrial areas whose land has, cumulatively, at least road access, paved public roads for pedestrian access, water drainage and public lighting;
c) Áreas recreativas, que sean de acceso: c) Recreational areas that are open to the public and in which there are permanent or temporary buildings or facilities for leisure, recreation or sport, which in any case include beaches that meet both requirements, as well as parks or gardens under the responsibility of local authorities.
Si el vuelo se produce en alguna de esta: If the flight takes place in any of these areas, UAS operators that are subject to the registration obligation must notify the Ministry of the Interior of their flight in advance, at least 5 calendar days before the planned start date of the operation.
Recuerde además que para el sobrevuelo o: Also remember that to overfly buildings or reduce minimum distances to them, in the open category, permission is required from the competent body, or from the owner or administrator responsible for the building or permanent structure.
